title: Securely shred a file with BleachBit
summary: Use BleachBit to securely shred a file so it cannot be recovered. This is useful for deleting sensitive data.

steps.explain: Shred a specific file so it cannot be recovered.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to securely delete

steps.expect: The file is overwritten and deleted.

warnings: Shredding is irreversible. The file cannot be recovered after this operation.

rollback.explain: Shredded files cannot be recovered. Ensure you have a backup if needed.
